name: 30820-longprompt-30b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90, driver 570 / CUDA 12.8.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, one in-process vLLM engine; the checkpoint is served whole on one card.
architecture: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM sparse MoE: 48 layers, hidden 2048, 32 query and 4 KV heads at head_dim 128, 128 experts with top-8 routing, moe_intermediate 768, vocab 151936, model window 40960; compressed-tensors W8A8 FP8 with block-wise weight scales, 31.2 GB over 7 safetensors shards.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup 25%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 1024 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, static seed 30820.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, text only: exactly 1024 prompt tokens in and exactly 256 tokens out per request (min == max on both ends), EOS ignored, temperature 0.0 (greedy).
purpose: A long-context document summarizer on a single H100, serving 256 concurrent users with page-length prompts and short summaries.
launch:
# The model and topology this setup serves, in the form `vllm serve --config` takes.
# ENGINE: source checkout d2dc5dfc6ecafbd3d725c1c42dd019db2b1efd30 (v0.13.0rc1-284-gd2dc5dfc6eca);
# the interpreter that holds it is named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`.
# Nothing here is tuned, and every argument not listed is left at the engine's own default for
# this device -- including gpu-memory-utilization, dtype, kv-cache-dtype, quantization,
# max-num-seqs, max-num-batched-tokens and enable-prefix-caching. No environment variables.

model: RedHatAI/Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8-block

# One card: the 31.2 GB quantized checkpoint fits one 80 GB H100 whole.
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# The workload's worst case is 1024 prompt + 256 generated = 1280 tokens, against a checkpoint
# window of 40960.
max-model-len: 2048
